intros.proofNote: One Real Estate Operating System for Ghana-first operations — with international rules where your workspace enables them.

faq.a: BaytMiftah is a Real Estate Operating System (REOS): one platform for property discovery and consumer journeys, plus a workspace for listings, leasing, collections, maintenance, and reporting.

faq.q: How is this different from a listings website?
faq.a: Listings are one module. BaytMiftah connects people, properties, money, and operations — from enquiry and application through lease, payment, and maintenance — with role-based workspace controls.

faq.q: What is the difference between the consumer app and workspace?
faq.a: The consumer app (com.baymiftah.app) is for search, applications, payments, and stays. Workspace (com.baymiftah.workspace) is for operators: CRM, listings, leases, finance, and field ops. Both use the same account and org model where applicable.

Yes. The product supports cedis, local trust and KYC workflows, and SMS/WhatsApp omnichannel patterns common in Ghana, with international rules and multi-currency options where enabled in your workspace.

BaytMiftah is a technology platform — not a bank. Payment checkout connects to configured providers (including mobile money where supported). Availability depends on workspace setup and verified provider credentials.
Create an account, explore properties, or set up a workspace and add properties and units. Import tools and module configuration depend on your rollout plan.
Native apps are rolling out via Google Play closed testing and Apple App Store review. Contact us to request tester access until public store links appear on this page.
Workspace AI uses limited tools, action logs, and human approval. Examples on this site use demo data — not live account data or autonomous decisions.
